degradesGracefully.statement: extraction/verify_all.py range-checks every citation whose file it can resolve. When no sibling source tree is present -- a zipped or standalone copy of design-repo/ -- the external citations simply cannot be resolved, and verify_all.py reports them as a WARNING and continues, rather than failing. Run it from inside the full project to range-check them for real.
degradesGracefully.rationale: A design-repo must verify cleanly as a standalone package. Its build-time evidence trail is still worth shipping, but it cannot be a hard dependency.

authoritativeMotionSource.statement: These three files carry provenance comments recording how each number was measured off the live original. They SUPERSEDE CLONE_SPEC.md wherever the two disagree. Two independent re-measurement passes (a pixel audit and an animation-QA pass) refuted the spec claims listed below.

supersededClaims.real: Two systems are genuinely scroll-scrubbed: the radix logo stack and the hero centre card.

Every real trigger observer is a bare {threshold: 0} with NO rootMargin. The features strip flips between rect.top 902 and 892 at a 900px viewport; .dashboard arms between 906 and 890 -- exactly the fold.
Not real behaviour. Cascades are one-shot; no `-active` class is ever removed, and nothing is re-armed.
Appears nowhere. The real steps are dashboard 833ms, MFA 1016ms, password 2017ms; cycles 6050ms (RBAC), 14081ms (leaked), 16264ms (MFA), 16134ms (password), 7999ms (complete progress).

supersededClaims.real: 9 bars on an 800ms re-roll in a 28px box (measured intervals 799/800/800/800/800/800/801/799/800/800).
5. Verified against the real LINES array.
367x367 is the intrinsic file size; the RENDERED box is 292x292.

A mid-expansion capture. Six sections use content-visibility:auto, so scrollHeight varies per pass on BOTH sides. Document height is NOT a fidelity metric for this project and is recorded nowhere in this package as a contract value.

supersededClaims.spec: CLONE_SPEC 4.1: canvas particle systems marked approximate
supersededClaims.real: Read off the original's own instrumented draw calls. count = round(w*h/1666.67) for the three starfields (938 @1280x1222, 828 @1280x1078, 395 @992x664) and round(w*h/553) at r=1.5 for the RBAC dot field (84 @128x363). Alpha is a raw Math.sin(phase) that emits negatives, so ~48% are mathematically invisible. White is the only fill colour. Starfield drift vy = -(0.1+rand*0.2) * h/1200, x never changes; dot field vx = -(1.2+rand*0.4) * w/1200, y never changes. All four canvases are lazily sized to their LAYOUT box on first intersection.

supersededClaims.spec: Earlier zero-crossing fits of 0.07 / 0.075 rad/frame for the twinkle phase step
supersededClaims.real: 0.062 rad/frame, derived ANALYTICALLY: cos(s) = (a0 + a2) / (2*a1) from three consecutive frames at full float precision over 724 particles; three independent estimators read 0.0653 / 0.0611 / 0.0623.

T0 is a CONSTANT rect.top 1080.5, independent of viewport height (1080.44 at vh=900, 1080.5 at vh=700). The (vh+180) form was a coincidence at vh=900 and was 200px off at vh=700. The span D is WIDTH-dependent: 539 at >=1200px, 471.5 below.

supersededClaims.spec: Hero card scrub with a hardcoded denominator of 1303
supersededClaims.real: y = clamp(25 - 50*(vh - rect.top)/(vh + 459), -25, 25). 459 is the card's own height, so the denominator tracks the viewport. Pinned at three heights: vh 844 -> slope 0.0383632, vh 900 -> 0.036786, vh 700 -> 0.043127. The hardcoded 1303 was exact only at 390x844 and ran 4.3% steep at 1280x900.

supersededClaims.spec: CLONE_SPEC 4.4: the RBAC lit-shape set unmeasured / one rotating glyph
supersededClaims.real: PER-ROLE, measured per frame over three full roles by DOM index, rest level 0.4: ADMIN lights all four [1,1,1,1]; VIEWER lights index 0 only [1,0.2,0.2,0.2]; EDITOR lights 0 and 3 [1,0.2,0.2,1].

groundworkCorrections.claim: '1044x492 grid of four 320x242 animated cards', naming four mechanisms
groundworkCorrections.finding: The real section renders FIVE cards: leaked-password, RBAC, password-strength, automatic-detection and multi-factor. The 320x242 card geometry is correct; the count is not.

Original-site measurements, not what the clone renders. The clone's own CSS gives all three cards ONE width (320px, 392px at >=640px) in a centred flex row with no absolute x positions; the left/right cards get an inline height of 392 and the centre card's own height is 459.

groundworkCorrections.finding: Nine SECTIONS produce EIGHT boundaries. The same file's `scope` field already states '4 of 8' correctly, so this is an internal inconsistency in the prose rather than a wrong measurement.

Neither 788 nor an 80px height appears anywhere in the clone's features-slider stylesheet. The real strip is a grid of fit-content columns (3 below 940px, 6 at and above) with a 48x48 icon box. 788x80 is an original-site measurement that the clone's CSS does not express.
